title: Gell-Mann Amnesia and Michio Kaku
summary: Physicist Angela Collier uses Gell-Mann amnesia to critique pop-science figures, especially Michio Kaku, and works through an eigenvalue problem along the way. It is a long, rambling commentary on how experts see simplified explanations of their own field.
why: HN commenters recommend it for the Gell-Mann amnesia framing and as a skeptical take on Michio Kaku.

quote.text: Dr Angela Collier has this fun concept she calls Mann-Gell Amnesia
